discovery.decisionRationale: Use the official 2014 NYC 3-D Building Model for lawful roof-form geometry if legal review approves redistribution, conflate it with current NYC building footprints and planimetrics, derive terrain from USGS 3DEP, and procedurally fill only documented gaps. No candidate below is runtime lineage until its bytes are acquired and SHA-256 pinned.

No marketplace or scraped landmark asset may enter the build without exact per-asset author, license, source URL, redistribution permission, and content hash.

The pinned Overture derivative already prioritizes and attributes OpenStreetMap while providing stable GERS IDs; a second direct extract would duplicate geometry and complicate conflation. Revisit only if a required OSM tag is absent from Overture.
